name: TL
title: A. TL
input_spec: The first line contains two integers n, m (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 100). The second line contains n space-separated positive integers a1, a2, ..., an (1 ≤ ai ≤ 100) — the running time of each of the n correct solutions in seconds. The third line contains m space-separated positive integers b1, b2, ..., bm (1 ≤ bi ≤ 100) — the running time of each of m wrong solutions in seconds.
output_spec: If there is a valid TL value, print it. Otherwise, print -1.
